edit.description: Wrap fs-call paths with namespacedJoin per platform-facts.md
Pin namespacedJoin usage on Baton's fs calls

summary: Baton's mkdirSync/existsSync/writeFileSync/rmSync build paths via bare join; wrap with namespacedJoin (win32 MAX_PATH fix)

per.section: Windows MAX_PATH (~260 chars) breaks fs calls with no long component

tests: Baton's fs calls (mkdirSync/existsSync/writeFileSync/rmSync/readdirSync) route through namespacedJoin, not bare join
acceptance: Baton.ts imports namespacedJoin from ./paths.js and uses it for every path passed to an fs call; new test fails on the pre-fix tree and passes after
notes: Same idiom already applied at job.ts, cli.ts, Dispatcher.ts consumer sites; Baton is the awake-flag mechanism (harness's only mutable state outside commits), so a deep flumeDir/job dir hits this for real.
